messages:
emma-pd: Heads-up 1: planning rollout for staged region switch (EU private customers). focus: feature-flag strategy, canary windows, and fast fallback.
ryan-sre: recommend two flags: `region-switch` and `kv-prime`. start with region-switch=false, kv-prime=false.
julia-cs: customers asked for tenant-level opt-in and a signed approval before final switch. we also need a comms checklist.
omar-sales: escrow the manual signoff in runbook; I'll own comms for contracted customers.
ryan-sre: proposed waves: 5% tenants (30m), 25% (30m), 60% (60m), 100%. capture p95, 503s, and auth failures. immediate rollback = flip flags + revoke newly issued keys.
emma-pd: add an A/B sample for quality: 0.5% mirrored to new pipeline, compare embeddings similarity and error rates. gate: quality delta <1.5%.
julia-cs: add a 15m pre-wave ping to #customers-ops and send email to tenant security contact.
canary-bot: smoke deploy started -> eu-serving:v89. health checks passing :white_check_mark:
emma-pd: action items: runbook (ryan), comms (omar), custody/approval flow (julia). shiproom tomorrow to approve cadence.
